# Testing / QA tools

6 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=testing`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `run_automated_tests`

Run GDScript test files under a given directory. Each .gd file is loaded and every method whose name starts with 'test_' is called. A method passes if it returns true (or nothing); it fails if it returns false or a dict with 'error'. Returns a summary with per-file and per-method pass/fail counts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `test_path` | `string` | — | res:// path prefix to search for test files (default 'res://tests/'). All .gd files under this path are included. |
| `test_filter` | `string` | — | Optional substring filter. Only files whose path contains this string are executed. |
| `timeout_sec` | `number` | — | Reserved for future use. Accepted but not yet enforced — a blocking test method will stall indefinitely regardless of this value. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/21-testing.json`, test QA-01:

```json
{
  "test_path": "res://tests/"
}
```

## `assert_node_state`

Assert that one or more properties of a node in the currently open scene match expected values. Use the 'assertions' array for multiple checks, or 'property'+'expected' for a single check. Returns {passed: bool, assertions: [{property, expected, actual, passed}]}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | NodePath relative to the scene root (e.g. 'Player', 'UI/HealthBar'). Use '.' or '' for the root node. |
| `assertions` | `array` | — | Array of {property: string, expected: any} objects to check. If omitted, use the top-level 'property' and 'expected' fields for a single assertion. Array items are `object`. |
| `property` | `string` | — | Property name for a single-assertion shortcut (ignored when 'assertions' is provided). |
| `expected` | any | — | Expected value for the single-assertion shortcut (string, number, boolean, or object). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/21-testing.json`, test QA-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": ".",
  "property": "visible",
  "expected": true
}
```

## `compare_screenshots`

Compare two screenshot files pixel-by-pixel and report the difference ratio. Returns {diff_ratio, threshold, passed} where diff_ratio is the fraction of differing pixels [0.0–1.0]. Useful for visual regression testing — take a baseline screenshot, make changes, take another, then compare.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `path_a` | `string` | yes | Path to the baseline screenshot (res:// or absolute OS path). |
| `path_b` | `string` | yes | Path to the screenshot to compare against the baseline. |
| `threshold` | `number` | — | Maximum allowed diff_ratio before the comparison fails (default 0.01 = 1%). Set to 0.0 to require a pixel-perfect match. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/21-testing.json`, test QA-09:

```json
{
  "path_a": "res://screenshot_qa.png",
  "path_b": "res://screenshot_qa.png"
}
```

## `record_test`

Start or stop recording a test interaction sequence, or add individual events to an in-progress recording. Use action='start' to begin, action='add_event' to append an event dict, action='stop' to finish. The returned 'events' array from action='stop' can be passed to replay_test.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `action` | `string` | yes | Recording control. One of: `"start"`, `"stop"`, `"add_event"`, `"status"`. |
| `test_name` | `string` | — | Name for the recording (used with action='start'). |
| `event` | `object` | — | Event dict to append when action='add_event'. Must include 'type': 'key_press' \| 'mouse_click' \| 'mouse_move' \| 'action' \| 'wait'. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/21-testing.json`, test QA-05:

```json
{
  "action": "start",
  "test_name": "mcp_e2e_rec"
}
```

## `replay_test`

Replay a list of recorded test events into the editor. Supports event types: key_press (keycode, ctrl, shift, alt), mouse_click (x, y, button), mouse_move (x, y), action (action_name), wait (seconds). Returns {replayed, total, errors, status}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `events` | `array` | yes | Array of event dicts to replay in order. Each must have a 'type' field. Use the output of record_test (action='stop') as input. Array items are `object`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/21-testing.json`, test QA-07:

```json
{
  "events": "$REC_EVENTS"
}
```

## `get_test_report`

Return the most recent test report produced by run_automated_tests. Returns the full report dict including per-file and per-method results, or an error if no report has been generated yet.

Takes no parameters.

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/21-testing.json`, test QA-02:

```json
{}
```
